thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: inference-api-prod p99 latency 3.2s (> SLO 1.2s) over 5m. PagerDuty PD-9876 fired and is routing to on-call.
Priya: saw it, looking now. any error spike or just tail latency?
pagerduty: PagerDuty: PD-9876 assigned to Priya (Oncall Eng). Escalation in 10m if unacked.
Priya: errors flat, 5xx ~0.2%, but p95->p99 jump across regions. likely hotkey / KV-cache churn or autoscaler lag.
Sean: putting an immediate mitigation: scale dedicated-infer pool +2 gpus, and route eu-traffic -> us-east-fallback for read-only routes.
Priya: executing scale command now:```/infra scale pool dedicated-infer --add 2 --reason "p99 burst"```
incident-bot: NOTE: autoscaler triggered scale up attempt at 4200246820, warmup expected ~90s.
Jon: Support: I have 4 customers reporting slow chat replies; not errors but UI waiting >6s for completions. Logging for those accounts shows long token generation stalls.
Marta: Finance: any chance this is batching policy suddenly increasing latency? saw a config rollout earlier today.
Priya: checking rollout - batching-opt changes rolled at 4199990000, not correlated. K/V cache hit-rate dropped 18% in eu-west, likely causing cold KV walks.
Sean: temporary workaround: disable aggressive multi-request batching for short requests (routes: /chat/light). Patching config now.
Priya: patch pushed to canary -> rolling to 10% routes. Monitoring tail.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation timer snoozed by 5m (auto-suppression) after Priya acknowledged. Re-notify on regression.
Priya: p99 trending down from 3.2s -> 1.6s after scale + config patch. still above SLO. continuing mitigation: trigger KV cache warmup for top 500 keys.
Sean: kicked a warmup job:```/jobs run kv-warmup --keys-file s3://ops/kv/warmup_top500.txt```
Jon: Customer impact summary for handoff: 4 active tickets, degraded UX only, no data loss. Major customers: AcmeCorp chat slow for 10-15% requests.
Priya: Handoff in 20m — I'll be offline for a meeting. Sean, taking over. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-slo-burn (see mitigation steps 1-5). PD incident PD-9876 remains open.
Sean: taking over, ack. I'll keep autoscaler pinned until p99 <1.2s for 15m, and coordinate with platform to evict noisy hotkeys if needed.
Marta: I'll notify account leads for AcmeCorp and flag they may see degraded session length; ops will follow up.
incident-bot: RESOLVE: auto-clear scheduled if metrics hold for 15m. PagerDuty PD-9876 still open until manual resolve.
Sean: note for postmortem: investigate autoscaler hysteresis + KV eviction thresholds; possible followup action: pre-warm KV cache during deploy windows.
Priya: thanks team. will add short blameless note and assign postmortem owner after incident closes.
Sean: closing loop: monitoring alert now at 1.1s p99. continuing to watch.
